entries.brief: Create ONE SQUARE original painterly fantasy spell icon for SKAZ, restrained fantasy encyclopedia. Broad sculpted brush shapes, compact clear silhouette readable at 32px, moderate detail, warm upper-left light, dark clean edge accents on light and dark backgrounds. Centered motif fills 70% square with 12% empty margins. TRUE TRANSPARENT background without haze. No scenery, text, letters, numerals, frame, logos or UI speech bubbles. Two small human faces in opposing profiles, one speaking and the other listening, joined by three short warm golden curved sound ribbons at mouth level. Faces rendered as dark bronze sculptural silhouettes, lips subtly open on speaker, attentive ear on listener. Visual metaphor for mutual spoken understanding, no written book, no scroll, no disembodied tongue, no rays between foreheads.
